articles.title: Letters: Birch Avenue Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the September meeting. To the editor: I have lived on Birch Avenue for 5 years, and I want to say what a difference the Eastgate Volunteer Fire Co. has made.
Please keep the sidewalk ramp in the budget. Many of us on Birch Avenue use it every week.
Thank you for printing this lctter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the September meeting.
Esther Kellerman, Canal Park
